given: a stock record already exists for a (sku, location) pair
when: a team member files that same (sku, location) pair again with a new quantity and tracking code
then: exactly one record exists for that pair, holding the newly filed values, with no second record stored for the pair

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover a first-time filing and its read-back; this AC observes collision resolution at write time (single record, no duplicate), which can break by storing two records while first-time filing still works.
